message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 103 (12232 cents) failed to record after two attempts; the handoff confirms no refund is recorded.

reply.thought: Order 103’s refund failed on both attempts and was not recorded, so the refunds were not completed as intended. I’m holding the batch for human review before any payouts.
